free_tier.stated: The Paris clearance tier lists an Atom C2350 at 1.7 GHz, 2 cores / 2 threads, 4 GB DDR3, 1 x 1 TB SATA HDD, 1 Gbps port with unmetered fair-usage bandwidth, at USD 14.28 a month with a second figure of USD 8.91 beside it and a setup fee of USD 5.95 reduced to USD 0.00; the euro column reads EUR 11.99 and EUR 7.49. The same page lists a Xeon E3-1220 at 4c/4t with 16 GB and 2 x 2 TB HDD at EUR 34.99 or EUR 15.99.
